race.description: Tomsy's Timbers Daniel Baker Remembrance Hcp (Bm50)
race.comment: TARA KODA (7) has been in the market at her last couple of runs but failed to threaten, the latest effort a modest tenth at this track over 1630m. Rates highly in this line up and can improve. RUBOLOGY (1) started at $4.60 last time and ran below expectations, finishing eighth over 1210m at Toowoomba. This is a nice drop in grade and is set to turn things around. RAINBOW LASS (5) was in contention on the bend and finished second last start over 1200m at Casino. Ready to go one better. AUREATE (3) settled well back from the inside draw last start before coming home nicely to finish fifth over 1100m at Gatton. Among the chances and will be tough to stop.
